content:
- Overestimate prices after recent spikes, especially when sentiment is high (sentiment > 0.36) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices during strong downward momentum if sentiment is low (sentiment < 0.20) — add 3–5% buffer to avoid premature bottoming.
- When sentiment is volatile (alternating high/low), model tends to overreact — dampen forecast volatility by smoothing 3–5 day moving average.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 2–4% unless sentiment supports continuation.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts often overshoot early in the cycle — cap forecast at 10% above 14-day moving average to avoid overextension.
- High sentiment + high price = overconfidence — reduce forecast by 3–5% if sentiment > 0.40 and price > 80.00.
